name: local
author: Ivan Zigoni
description: Single MCP server hosting this workspace's Claude Code tools (currently: safe-query, ported from the pctk__util__safe-query skill; safe-curl, which parses a pasted curl command and executes it via undici, mechanically rejecting any Cookie/Authorization header the curl itself sets and injecting one instead from the env var registered for the call's authProfile (see src/tools/safe-curl/auth-profiles.json) in this server's own .env, so a real auth cookie never has to appear as a tool argument or in chat; bitbucket-open-pr, which calls the Bitbucket Cloud REST API to open a pull request, authenticating with Basic auth — Atlassian account email + API token — resolved from the env var pair registered for the call's authProfile, same registry pattern as safe-curl's auth-profiles.json but for a credential pair instead of a single cookie; workspace and repoSlug are call arguments, so one authProfile works against any repository the token can reach; portainer-get-container-logs, which reads the raw log stream of a single container (one Swarm service replica, not an aggregate across replicas) from a registered Portainer environment; deepseek-infer, which sends a prompt to the Deepseek chat-completions API and returns its response as plain text, for offloading large-context or high-volume inference work away from the calling session's own context — the API key is injected server-side from this server's own .env, never a tool argument). Every tool also accepts an optional outputFileName (shared src/shared/tool-output.ts) to write its full result to this server's own managed output directory instead of inlining it, for results large enough to flood context.
